newsitem.title: USA: Smith Corona to emerge from bankruptcy.
newsitem.headline: Smith Corona to emerge from bankruptcy.

text.p: Smith Corona Corp said it plans to complete the remaining steps required to implement its plan of reorganization on February 28 and emerge from Chapter 11 bankruptcy.

It said that on the effective date of its emergence, it will make required cash and stock distributions to its distributing agent and enter into a new $25 million credit facility to support ongoing operations.

Smith Corona said W. Michael Driscoll will assume responsibilities for Ronald Stengel as president and chief executive as previously announced. Stengel will serve as a director of the reorganized company.
It says it has application pending with the NASDAQ exchange to list the reorganized company's stock under the symbol "SCCO".
